name: pink.get_budget
description: What this agent may still spend: monthly budget left, spent today, single-payment cap, vault balances, company daily ceiling.

name: pink.list_payees
description: Suppliers, platforms and contractors this company has approved. Paying anyone else stops and asks a person.

name: pink.list_rules
description: The policy rules that apply to this agent, in evaluation order. First match decides: allow, ask, or block.

name: pink.check_policy
description: Dry run. Returns would_allow / would_ask / would_block with the rule and the full decision trace. Nothing is spent or held.

arguments.name: payee_id
arguments.desc: Id from pink.list_payees. Omit for a payee not on the list.

arguments.name: payee_name
arguments.desc: Name of the payee. Required if payee_id is omitted.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.desc: Amount in the payment currency

arguments.name: currency
arguments.desc: USD, EUR, GBP, HKD, SGD, or JPY

arguments.name: purpose
arguments.desc: What this payment is for, in one line (shown to approvers)

arguments.name: reason
arguments.desc: Why you are making it now (shown to approvers)

arguments.name: evidence
arguments.desc: References you can attach: PO number, invoice id, ticket id, statement id, photos

arguments.name: evidence_flags
arguments.desc: Structured evidence/signal flags

arguments.name: local_hour
arguments.desc: Dry run only: simulate this hour of day (0-23)

name: pink.request_payment
description: The real call. Returns allowed with a single-use credential, pending_human with a hold_id while a person is asked, or blocked with the reason.

arguments.name: payee_id
arguments.desc: Id from pink.list_payees. Omit for a payee not on the list.

arguments.name: payee_name
arguments.desc: Name of the payee. Required if payee_id is omitted.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.desc: Amount in the payment currency

arguments.name: currency
arguments.desc: USD, EUR, GBP, HKD, SGD, or JPY

arguments.name: purpose
arguments.desc: What this payment is for, in one line

arguments.name: reason
arguments.desc: Why you are making it now

arguments.name: evidence
arguments.desc: References you can attach

arguments.name: evidence_flags
arguments.desc: Structured evidence/signal flags

arguments.name: local_hour
arguments.desc: Dry run only

arguments.name: idempotency_key
arguments.desc: Unique string per payment attempt so retries are safe

name: pink.get_credential
description: Check a pending payment. When a person approves, this returns the credential. Also works for any payment_id.

arguments.name: hold_id
arguments.desc: The hold_id / payment_id returned by pink.request_payment

name: pink.report_receipt
description: After paying, file the receipt or invoice so the payment is reconciled.

arguments.name: receipt
arguments.desc: merchant, total, currency, reference, url, note
